description: Read-only: fetches current quote/last-price data from the signed-in user's saved broker connection. Pass brokerCredentialId, or omit it only when the user has exactly one active saved broker connection. Use symbols for one or more assets. Use quoteSymbol only for crypto or forex. For options pass assetType option plus expiration, strike, and right; for dated futures pass assetType future plus expiration and exchange. Never pass raw broker credentials, API keys, account tokens, broker_config, bot_config, code, or env vars.

outcome.description: Selected prediction contract outcome; Kalshi uses yes or no.

name: get_broker_quotes
title: Get broker quotes
